d:
Watch the official video of “Zaar Zaar” now!
Elli AvrRam returns with a captivating dance performance in “Zaar Zaar”, Rusha & Blizza’s most cinematic and emotionally charged track yet. With Neeti Mohan’s haunting vocals and a powerful verse by Farhan Khan, the song embodies the essence of ‘zaar zaar’ - to weep uncontrollably - while transforming it into a bold, high-energy dance anthem for the festive season.
Stream Zaar Zaar now on you favorite Platforms:
Track Credits:
Produced and Composed by Rusha & Blizza
Vocals by Neeti Mohan, Farhan Khan
